items.title: Ray Bauduc and Nappy Lamare Interview, 1959-09-09
items.q: Yeah, one of Johnny's records on OK came out, and Tom Brown and some of them were on that.

ctx.x: Well, the first record I actually made never did come out. It was made in Richmond, Indiana, with Johnny Bisonoff, his band. Oh, yeah. But they never did release those records. It was just a little bit after the Wolverines made their records.
Yeah, one of Johnny's records on OK came out, and Tom Brown and some of them were on that.

items.title: Ray Bauduc Interview, 1984-06-27
items.q: And, uh, um, and Dr. Shushaw and, uh, when we played the St. Charles Hotel there.

ctx.x: And, uh, um, and Dr. Shushaw and, uh, when we played the St. Charles Hotel there. Yeah. He played good trombone, you know, he played, because he, he first went to New York and, and had musical clowns, see? Mm-hmm. Something like that was his band. I don't know whether he talked, talked to him or not.
Yeah, but not enough, you know, I used to talk to him in his, in the big, you know. Well, he was a brother of Red Brown and played string bass with the Rhythm Kings.
